problems.intro: Most service businesses don't lose customers because of price or quality. They lose them in the minutes and hours between a message and a reply.
problems.item1Body: Messages on WhatsApp, Instagram and web forms wait hours for an answer, and the client books with a competitor.
problems.item2Body: Evenings and weekends are when many clients reach out, and nobody is there to respond.
problems.item3Body: Manual reminders are forgotten, leaving empty slots and lost revenue.
problems.item4Body: Contacts live in chats, spreadsheets and notebooks, so follow-ups slip through the cracks.
problems.item5Body: The team spends hours answering people who were never going to buy.
problems.item6Body: The same questions, confirmations and data entry every single day.
problems.closing: Every unanswered message is a move your competitor makes first.

process.titlePre: From first call to fully automated
process.intro: A clear, low-effort process. You bring the knowledge of your business, we handle everything else.
process.note: Timelines are indicative and depend on the project scope.
process.step1Body: A free call to map how leads reach you today, where they get lost and which tasks eat your team's time.
process.step2Body: We design the automation flows, the conversation scripts in your brand voice and the integrations with your calendar and tools.
process.step3Body: We build, test with real scenarios, train the AI on your services and go live with your team.
process.step4Body: Monthly reporting, conversation reviews and improvements, so results keep compounding.

benefits.intro: Automation pays for itself by recovering revenue you are already losing and giving your team back their time.
benefits.tile1Body: Leads get an answer while they are still interested.
benefits.tile2Body: Capture enquiries at night, on weekends and during busy hours.
benefits.tile3Body: Reminders and easy rescheduling keep the calendar full.
benefits.tile4Body: Your team stops answering the same questions and focuses on clients.
benefits.outcome1: More booked appointments from the same number of leads
benefits.outcome2: Higher conversion from first message to sale
benefits.outcome3: Consistent, professional replies in three languages
benefits.outcome4: A clean pipeline with no forgotten follow-ups
benefits.outcome5: Clear monthly reporting on what the automation delivers
benefits.outcome6: A business that scales without hiring for repetitive work
benefits.caseTitle: A dental clinic that stopped losing WhatsApp enquiries
benefits.caseBody: Missed WhatsApp messages are answered and booked automatically, day and night.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
sections.body: [Legal company name], with tax ID [NIF/CIF], registered address at [Registered address], is the data controller responsible for the personal data you share through this website. You can contact us at [Contact email].

sections.heading: 2. What data we collect
sections.body: When you submit the contact form we collect your name, email address, phone number, job title, company details, the information you share about your automation needs, and technical data such as your IP address, browser, and the pages you visited before submitting (UTM parameters, referrer).

sections.heading: 3. Purpose of processing
sections.body: We use your data to respond to your enquiry, prepare a proposal, manage our commercial relationship, and, only with your separate consent, send you occasional news and automation tips.

sections.heading: 4. Legal basis
sections.body: The legal basis for processing is your consent, given when you submit the contact form and accept this Privacy Policy, in line with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Spain's Ley Orgánica 3/2018 (LOPDGDD).

sections.heading: 5. Recipients and processors
sections.body: Your data may be shared with service providers acting as processors under contract, including [CRM provider: GoHighLevel / HighLevel] for pipeline and workflow management, and [Cloudflare] for hosting, security, spam protection (Turnstile) and cookieless analytics (Web Analytics). Some of these providers may process data outside the European Economic Area; in that case appropriate safeguards apply, such as the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses.

sections.heading: 6. Data retention
sections.body: We keep your data for as long as necessary to handle your enquiry and manage our relationship, and afterwards for the periods required by applicable law.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights
sections.body: You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection, and withdraw your consent at any time, by writing to [Contact email]. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (agpd.es).

sections.heading: 8. International transfers
sections.body: [International data transfer details to be completed once the CRM and hosting configuration is finalised, including the specific safeguards applied.]

sections.heading: 1. What are cookies
sections.body: Cookies are small files stored on your device that help websites function and, with your consent, understand how they are used.

sections.heading: 2. Cookies we use
sections.body: Necessary cookies are always active and are required for the site to work. Analytics cookies (used only with your consent) help us understand traffic through Cloudflare Web Analytics, which is cookieless by design. Marketing cookies, used only with your consent, may be added in the future for advertising purposes.

sections.heading: 3. Managing your preferences
sections.body: You can accept, reject or customise non-essential cookies from the banner shown on your first visit, and change your choice at any time from the link below.

sections.heading: 4. Change your preferences
sections.body: Use the link below to reopen the cookie preferences panel.

sections.heading: 1. Your rights under the GDPR
sections.body: Under the GDPR and Spain's LOPDGDD, you have the right to access the personal data we hold about you, request its rectification or erasure, restrict or object to its processing, and request the portability of your data.

sections.heading: 2. How to exercise your rights
sections.body: Send a written request to [Contact email], including a copy of an identity document, specifying which right you wish to exercise. We will respond within one month, as required by applicable law.

sections.heading: 3. Data protection officer
sections.body: [Data protection officer / contact person, if applicable].

sections.heading: 4. Supervisory authority
sections.body: If you believe your rights have not been respected, you can lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (Agencia Española de Protección de Datos, agpd.es).

sections.heading: 1. Ownership of the website
